reason: A DeepSeek Harness integration that retrieves configured provider account balances and displays them per route in the Models settings page.

summaries.zh: 在模型设置页按提供商路由查询并显示账户余额。
summaries.en: Queries and displays account balances for configured provider routes in the Models settings page.

capabilities: Reads configured provider route credentials and endpoints through the host configuration and credential interfaces
Displays provider account balances in the Models settings page
Registers a loopback RPC channel between the browser and host plugin
